title: SpaceX 已向 SEC 递交保密 IPO 申请，承销商名单曝光
summary: 知情人士透露，SpaceX 于 4 月 1 日正式提交保密 IPO 申请，高盛与摩根士丹利担任联席主承销商，目标估值区间 $3500 亿–$4000 亿美元，S-1 最快 5 月初公开。

title: OKXICE moves ahead with tokenized stocks as blue chips push back
summary: The Nov. 23 debut puts a new SEC exemption to the test as Nasdaq pursues its own tokenized stock plans after warning that trading across platforms could fragment liquidity.

title: OpenAI’s quarterly revenue reportedly crosses $10B for the first time
summary: Sales of $10 billion represents an almost 50% jump from revenue of $6.7 billion the company recorded in the second quarter.

title: OKX-ICE Tokenized Stock Venue Sets Launch, Turning to Crypto Companies After Big Tech Opts Out
summary: OKXICE will open its tokenized securities venue Nov. 23 with more than 70 assets, led by crypto companies like Coinbase, Circle, Robinhood and Strategy, after 67 companies objected to having their shares listed.

summary: The expansion takes xStocks past 1,500 tokenized assets, though the new UK tokens still can't be bought by investors in the UK.

title: Kraken parent adds over 200 tokenized UK and EU stocks to xStocks
summary: The expansion adds more than 200 tokenized UK and EU equities, including all 40 companies in Germany’s DAX index, as xStocks plans further expansion into Hong Kong.

title: Bitget Wallet reports sevenfold jump in crypto phishing risk alerts
summary: The wallet flagged about 37,000 signing requests a week for phishing in Q3 and said better monitoring likely contributed to the increase.

title: ECB warns legislative delays could postpone digital euro launch
summary: ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone warned EU lawmakers that delays in finalizing digital euro legislation could push back its potential 2029 rollout.

title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
summary: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.

title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
summary: Each of the seven co-founders plans to sell exactly the same number of shares in the IPO, which would bring each of them about $250 million in cash at the midpoint of the price range while leaving the group in control of the company.

title: Elon Musk Calls Claude Opus 5.5 a 'Masterpiece', Admits Grok 4.8 Won't Match It

title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M

title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery

title: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google

title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
summary: As participants talk, Claude can draft the plan being discussed, map out a timeline on a whiteboard, answer questions in the meeting chat, and access connected work apps to retrieve information, such as last year's figures.
